notice: Provisional assessment basis. Numerical checks do not establish overall compliance. The supplied manual has preliminary approval; final approval and current applicability remain unconfirmed.

requirements.title: General intact stability
requirements.requirement: Area 0–30° ≥ 0.055 m·rad; 0–X ≥ 0.090 m·rad; 30°–X ≥ 0.030 m·rad. X is 40° or the smaller downflooding angle. GZ ≥ 0.20 m at an angle ≥ 30°; maximum GZ angle ≥ 25°; corrected initial GM ≥ 0.15 m.
requirements.gap: GM uses documented KMt interpolated at current displacement and initial trim, with physical KG and one FSM correction. Other criteria retain unresolved flooding and one-sided/continuous-curve limitations. Numerical results are not overall approval.

requirements.title: Wind and rolling
requirements.requirement: MSC.267(85); steady heel ≤ min(16°, 80% of deck-edge immersion angle), and gust/roll energy area b ≥ a.
requirements.gap: Gust, empirical roll and energy calculations are implemented with explicit missing-data guards. Condition-specific port-side reference curves and deck-immersion summary limits are extracted; a general two-sided grid, condition-dependent LWL/CB and verified final opening limits remain unavailable.

requirements.title: Downflooding
requirements.requirement: Only unprotected openings limit intact stability in this source. Two engine-room supply vents are listed; threshold samples cover starboard heel and constant LCB.
requirements.gap: Preliminary sample screening is implemented in Stability Curves and calculated heel. PDF 18 requires vent positions to be updated to the final Damage Control Plan. Missing thresholds, exact onset and port-side behaviour remain unresolved.

requirements.title: Limiting KG / damage stability
requirements.requirement: Chapter 5 references SOLAS 2009 II-1 Part B-1. The cover directs the limiting curves on printed pages 13.82–13.83 for all trims and arbitrary deck loading.
requirements.gap: Annotated limiting KG is interpolated by moulded draught and compared with both physical and corrected KG. Final approval scope and the red DAM-GM free-surface convention remain unconfirmed; no compliance verdict.

requirements.title: Permissible trim
requirements.requirement: At moulded draught 4.400 m: −2.620 to −1.380 m; at 6.560 and 8.000 m: −1.860 to +0.620 m. Interpolate intermediate values. Negative is stern trim.
requirements.gap: Automatic numerical trim check uses mean draught at half LPP and subtracts 0.011 m from underside keel per PDF 5 and 32–33. Overall approval remains unconfirmed.

requirements.title: Free-surface effects
requirements.requirement: Account for departure, arrival and the most onerous transitory ballast stage; assess liquid transfers at each relevant filling level.
requirements.gap: The current virtual-KG correction does not establish validation of all tank/heel effects or intermediate transfer conditions.

requirements.title: Load lines
requirements.requirement: Type B load line; summer reference: 8.011 m from underside keel (8.000 m moulded), 13976.39 t at density 1.025 t/m³ and zero trim.
requirements.gap: This is a summer reference, not a universal maximum. Seasonal, density, draught-mark and operating conditions require assessment.

requirements.title: Special cargo operations
requirements.requirement: Cover annotations require the approved Container Securing Manual for containers and cite A.715(17) for timber deck cargo.
requirements.gap: The supplied Cargo Securing Manual names Vectis Isle, hull YZJ2011-999. Its applicability to Vectis Castle, hull YZJ2011-1000, is unconfirmed. The cover also refers to a separate container securing manual.

requirements.title: Current approval basis
requirements.requirement: Cover: Preliminary; GL stamp: Preliminary Approved, 14 December 2012, reference 12-136583. Revision history is blank.
requirements.gap: Search of 35 supplied PDFs and vessel cover review did not locate the final approval letter or a separately identified final Damage Control Plan. Final revision, current flag/class and applicable amendments remain unconfirmed.

reviewNotes: Red annotations were visually reviewed. PDF text extraction misses the −1.860 m trim correction and the replacement DAM-GM tables.
PDF 15 contains a worked KG example with inconsistent draught references; it is not used as a numerical validation case.
The source particulars appear to interchange Flag and Port of Registry and leave construction dates blank. Do not infer present registration or rule applicability from them.
PDF 2 requires Tank Sounding Manual 076-180, Damage Control Manual 076-125 and Damage Control Plan 100-075. The cover also refers to an approval letter; its scope remains to be verified.
Search found no final approval letter. The supplied Cargo Securing Manual is headed Vectis Isle; do not assume ship-specific approval for Vectis Castle.
PDF 18 marks both engine-room supply vents for update to the final Damage Control Plan. Threshold screening retains this unresolved source qualification.

PDF 5 defines mean draught at half LPP; PDF 32–33 examples establish a 0.011 m underside-keel to moulded conversion for the hydrostatics. The annotated KG table retains its own distinct printed draught pairs.

weatherEvidence.scope: Condition-specific port-side references only; not a general interpolation table or current-condition limits.
weatherEvidence.validation: Every curve, total-weight and summary numeric token independently matched PDFium and pdfplumber. Source PDFs unchanged.

weatherEvidence.waterlineFinding: Waterline review: PDF 34 lists design LWL 123.950 m, breadth 17.400 m and design draught 8.000 m; PDF 5 lists block coefficient 0.8026. No condition-dependent LWL/CB table was identified in the seven vessel documents. These design particulars are not applied automatically.
